option_relations.rationale: HTRA1-related autosomal dominant cerebral small vessel disease is a distinct genetic form of small vessel disease, not directly related to Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy (CAA).
Hypertensive Small Vessel Disease is a distinct etiology of cerebral small vessel disease, separate from Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy.
Hereditary Cerebral Small Vessel Disease (HTRA1-related) is a specific genetic form of small vessel disease, not directly related to Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy (CAA).
Heterozygous HTRA1-related cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) is a specific genetic form of small vessel disease, not directly related to Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy (CAA).
